scenario_text: A two-state neutral particle system oscillates between two distinct flavor identities as it propagates. The probability of detecting the original flavor varies periodically with the distance traveled and the energy of the beam. The oscillation frequency is set by a small mass-squared difference between the underlying states. The measured survival probability reveals the coherent mixing.
